notes.title: Quick Hits: Using the Gun
notes.content:
DEEP BLAST RUSH LORE: 
Your ship's machine gun is overheated and weakened, so bullets will never be as powerful as bombs. 
If you choose to use it in LS Mode, you get extra points per hit. Pair that with blasting and gusting for maximum score!


Shoot them up in the Blast Rush LS Demo! (Wow that'd be a good name for these games)


[previewyoutube="eGKwWRw-muM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: Flash Rush
notes.content:
Flash Rush is the second Blast Box minigame in Blast Rush LS! 
Only your flashlight can briefly expose cloaked enemies so they can be shot down. It's also the only part in the game where the gun is more powerful!


Try it in the Blast Rush LS Demo!


[previewyoutube="o19lALcVqLQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: Time Attack
notes.content:
Time Attack is the first of four all-new minigames in the Blast Rush LS "Blast Box!" 
It's a unique 3-minute run where you can grab time emblems to push back the clock and stay in the game.


Try it in the Blast Rush LS Demo!


[previewyoutube="aH79mTYT3aE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: Gusting
notes.content:
Moving your ship back and forth quickly can kick up "gusts." 
While powerful as a bomb, gusting is also a key scoring technique in most game modes: Each hit activates the gust multiplier, which can add up to 9x the score value!


Practice your gusting in the Blast Rush LS Demo!


[previewyoutube="TTx_j_UM-HI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: Bomb Types
notes.content:
Blast Rush LS adds 6 new bomb types to the original 3 -- a total of 9 ways to blast! 
Each ship owns their own category of bombs: the BR-15 has Direct (big and brief); the Dignity Saber has Lob (grenade/missile), and the Crystal Heron has Roll (screen-clearers that "roll" across the screen). Find what fits you best!
Bombs D1, L2 and R3 are available to try in the Blast Rush LS Demo!

[previewyoutube="acaTZm3No1o;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: 2-Minute
notes.content:
The Standard and Endurance styles in Blast Rush LS have "2-Minute" variants, challenging you to get the best scores under the time limit! 
And for BRLS, they get new dedicated music! 

Play 2-Minute in the BRLS Demo to sample the action ahead!


Check out a full run here:


[previewyoutube="sEZZEzARokY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quick Hits: LS Mode
notes.content:
Blast Rush LS is a shoot-em-up with infinite bombs, and "bullet hell" where the enemies are the bullets! 


Under "LS Mode" you'll find one of the two main gameplay styles, Standard: a great way to get acquainted with blasting and leaving a trail of destruction through dozens of enemy waves!

The other style is Endurance: an endless, randomized challenge that tests your survival skills! Some of these waves will seem familiar from Standard, but others will "break the rules" to keep you on your toes!
